title: Tea Blend
statement: Given up to 2·10^5 values a_i ≤ 10^6, the task counts pairs (i, j) for which a_i times the prefix product a_1·…·a_j has an odd number of divisors, i.e. is a perfect square. Each value reduces to its square-free part (prime-exponent parities); since the prefix's odd-prime set can be huge, primes get random 64-bit keys (XOR hashing), the prefix becomes a prefix XOR, and matching hashes are counted.
